item.description:
• Health now shows only what needs you, with your Kit's last deep dream stage by stage, how long it took and what it cost.
  • Activity puts what is going on now in its own block, lists each day by when things started, folds a night into one card, and files late-evening sessions under the right day.
  • Catching up on your recent sessions stays in the background instead of opening the dreaming screen, and the home screen's links and words sit cleanly.
